summary: iOS sidebar behavior tests replay validated shared v1 fixtures through production view, edit and feed conversions.

replay.detail: Test coverage only; no persisted data is replayed or migrated.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or coordination change.

compatibility.detail: No runtime API, client behavior, protocol or harness compatibility change.

downtime.detail: No deployment, service restart or interruption required.

manual.detail: No upgrade steps required; the focused iOS test uses the existing development environment.

recovery.detail: Revert the test, shared fixture loader and documentation changes if needed; no stored state requires recovery.
